title: ID0418337-DC/Si-D/IL-[Y2 / R2 312900727025] Error during charging
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
I would like to report an issue that occurred during a charging session on 10/04/2025 at 19:03:06.607, at station No. 312900727025 in Yavne, with transaction number 109842.
Solution: Most likely grid issue, charger went offline without any warning or errors from PLC
During the charging process, the station simply shut down in the middle of the session. We would appreciate it if you could investigate the cause of this issue and advise on how to prevent similar occurrences in the future.

additional_info.subject: ID0418337-DC/Si-D/IL-[Y2 / R2 312900727025] Error during charging CRM:02679000079
additional_info.body:
Hello Ziv, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I am showing you below a screenshot of the logs previous to the error and after the error (all times in GMT)
Here as you can see, the time period from the logs stopped at 16:03 which means that the charger went offline at this period in time.
And reconnected at 8:51 after a reboot locally
From our side, it's not possible that the PLC shutdowns without any error or warning message. I can only think that this was a problem from the grid side, which cutoff the whole power supply to the charger. Also, if there was a problem with the PLC and we lost connection to the backend, when it would be recovered we would be able to see the error in the logs.
But here, we don't see, it's as if the power supply to the PLC was cutoff and no time to provide any message.
The charger is online again and running.
Since I've answered to all your needs, please let me know if I can close the ticket or if you have any other questions or doubts.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
